deficiencies.description: The rewrite claims that the slice through the tumour illustrates the process of explanting it, which the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors, often they will explant the tumor.
considerations.reason: Introductory conversational phrases like 'So the other thing to appreciate is that' and 'if you like' were correctly omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The removal of 'really' does not alter the factual claim or remove a hedge; it is merely a stylistic change.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: These remarks to the audience and self-corrections are correctly omitted as they are not subject matter.
